CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_send_message(p_sender uuid, p_recipient uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select p_sender=auth.uid()
    and (
      p_sender=p_recipient
      or (
        exists(select 1 from public.contacts c where c.owner_id=p_sender and c.contact_id=p_recipient)
        and exists(select 1 from public.contacts c where c.owner_id=p_recipient and c.contact_id=p_sender)
      )
    )
    and not exists(
      select 1 from public.blocks b
      where (b.owner_id=p_sender and b.blocked_id=p_recipient)
         or (b.owner_id=p_recipient and b.blocked_id=p_sender)
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cancel_friend_request(p_request_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.friend_requests set status='cancelled',responded_at=now()
  where id=p_request_id and sender_id=auth.uid() and status='pending';
  if not found then raise exception 'Solicitud no encontrada o no autorizada'; end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clear_conversation(p_peer uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 insert into public.conversation_state(owner_id,peer_id,cleared_at,updated_at)
 values(auth.uid(),p_peer,now(),now())
 on conflict(owner_id,peer_id) do update set cleared_at=excluded.cleared_at,updated_at=now();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.find_latest_conversation_room(p_peer_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select gc.id
  from public.group_conversations gc
  where exists(
    select 1 from public.group_conversation_members a
    where a.conversation_id=gc.id and a.user_id=auth.uid()
  )
  and exists(
    select 1 from public.group_conversation_members b
    where b.conversation_id=gc.id and b.user_id=p_peer_id
  )
  and (
    select count(*) from public.group_conversation_members m
    where m.conversation_id=gc.id
  ) > 2
  order by gc.created_at desc
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_group_invite_candidates(p_conversation_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, email text, display_name text, personal_message text, display_picture text, status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_me uuid:=auth.uid();
  v_host uuid;
begin
  if v_me is null then raise exception 'No autenticado'; end if;

  select gc.created_by into v_host
  from public.group_conversations gc
  where gc.id=p_conversation_id;

  if v_host is null or v_host<>v_me then
    raise exception 'Solo el administrador puede invitar participantes';
  end if;

  return query
  select p.id,p.email,p.display_name,p.personal_message,p.display_picture,p.status
  from public.contacts c
  join public.profiles p on p.id=c.contact_id
  where c.owner_id=v_me
    and not exists(
      select 1
      from public.group_conversation_members gm
      where gm.conversation_id=p_conversation_id
        and gm.user_id=p.id
    )
  order by p.display_name,p.email;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_mutual_contact_ids()
 RETURNS TABLE(contact_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select c.contact_id
  from public.contacts c
  where c.owner_id=auth.uid()
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.contacts r
      where r.owner_id=c.contact_id
        and r.contact_id=c.owner_id
    )
  order by c.created_at;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id,email,display_name)
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.email,''),
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'display_name', split_part(coalesce(new.email,'Messenger User'),'@',1), 'Messenger User')
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_conversation_read(p_peer_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'

  update public.messages set read_at=coalesce(read_at,now())
  where recipient_id=auth.uid() and sender_id=p_peer_id and read_at is null;
$function$

functions.name: mark_presence_offline
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_presence_offline()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  update public.profiles
  set status = 'offline',
      last_seen_at = null,
      updated_at = now()
  where id = auth.uid();
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_reciprocal_contact_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if pg_trigger_depth() < 2 then
    delete from public.contacts
    where owner_id=old.contact_id and contact_id=old.owner_id;
  end if;

  delete from public.friend_requests
  where (sender_id=old.owner_id and receiver_id=old.contact_id)
     or (sender_id=old.contact_id and receiver_id=old.owner_id);

  return old;
end;
$function$
